title: Arrow portrait carousel (Springs)
source: springs.estate residences carousel. Engine = library/components/portrait-carousel (proven, imperative go/current). NO engine patch needed.
engine: A vertical push-slice of portrait cards + copy-lag + ken-burns. Imperative: go(dir) steps ±1, current(), wires the ← → buttons.
differs: Same push-slice mechanic + same go(dir). INTERACTION differs (not the driver source but the INPUT): desktop uses the ← → outline buttons (click/arrow keys); mobile uses touch-swipe on the frame AND an ambient auto-advance timer so the slider lives without a tap. Springs mobile is a swipeable, self-advancing slider; desktop is arrow-paged.

desktop.driver: arrowNav — the engine already wired .pc-prev/.pc-next; nothing extra.

mobile.driver: swipeAuto — touch-swipe left/right → go(±1); + setInterval auto-advance that pauses briefly after a manual swipe.

copyLagMs.what: how far the copy lags the image.

kenBurns.what: slow scale drift on the active image.

engine_patch: NONE — imperative engine, no scroll driver, no narrow-guard (already responsive: grid collapses at 820px). The wrapper only adds mobile touch-swipe + auto-advance; desktop uses the engine's own arrow wiring.
entry: PortraitCarouselDual.init(target, opts) -> { platform, engine, driver }. Load engine.js THEN component.js. Markup: .pc-stage > .pc-frame + .pc-copy + .pc-prev/.pc-next + .pc-slide[data-image,data-copy] children.
law: transform (image push + ken-burns) + opacity (copy crossfade) only; GPU layers; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop over the moving image; NO WebGL. reduced-motion → hard cut (no push/ken-burns).
